map.由样本量、样本比例与置信水平算误差范围: Compute the margin of error from sample size, sample proportion and confidence level
map.支持有限总体校正：填入总体大小 N 后结果会更小: Supports finite population correction: entering the population size N gives a smaller result
map.用于判断调查或抽样的精度是否够用: For judging whether a survey or sample is precise enough
map.调查报道里“±3%”的误差幅度计算。: Computing the '±3%' error margin seen in survey reports.
map.设计问卷时反推样本量：若要求误差不超过 ±3%（95% 置信度），按最大方差估算: Back out the sample size when designing a questionnaire: if the error must be within ±3% (95% confidence), estimating at maximum variance needs roughly 1000 or more valid responses.
map.填样本量 n（不少于 2）: Fill in the sample size n (at least 2)
map.填样本比例 p̂，取值在 0 到 1 之间；没有先验时常用 0.5 取最保守值: Fill in the sample proportion p-hat, between 0 and 1; with no prior, 0.5 is the usual conservative choice
map.若总体规模有限且抽样比例不低，填总体大小 N 启用有限总体校正（留空按无限总体算: If the population is limited and the sampling fraction is not small, enter the population size N to enable finite population correction (leave blank for an infinite population)
map.看误差范围：若宽到无法区分两个方案，先加大样本量而不是降低置信水平: Look at the margin of error: if it is too wide to distinguish two options, increase the sample size rather than lower the confidence level
map.因此实操中通常在 1000–2000 份之间权衡，而非一味加大: In practice the trade-off is usually between 1000 and 2000 responses rather than simply going bigger
map.样本越大误差越小？: Does a larger sample mean smaller error?
map.MoE 与 √n 成反比，翻倍样本只降约 29%。: MoE is inversely proportional to √n, so doubling the sample only cuts it by about 29%.
map.为什么样本到一定数量后收益变小？: Why do gains shrink after a certain sample size?
map.因为误差与 √n 成反比：样本从 100 增到 400，误差减半；但要再减半就得: Because the error is inversely proportional to √n: raising the sample from 100 to 400 halves the error, but halving it again requires 1600. Doubling precision takes four times the sample while cost grows linearly. In practice the trade-off is usually between 1000 and 2000 responses rather than simply going bigger.
